{{Quote|Spirits of Cadomai!|Marn Hierogryph|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 43">[[Knights of the Old Republic 43|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 43]]</ref>}}
'''Cadomai Prime''', also known as simply '''Cadomai''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Catarlo sector/Legends|Catarlo sector]], along the northern end of the major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. A [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] world with intolerably cold [[Winter/Legends|winters]], Cadomai's tundra plains were home to the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] renowned for its art. Cadomai held a large system of subterranean [[Cave/Legends|caverns]], where the Snivvians made their homes during the subfreezing winters. The world possessed a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and was part of the [[Cadomai system/Legends|Cadomai system]]. Cadomai had a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government, with a leader chosen every [[Standard year/Legends|year]] solely on the basis of [[Artist/Legends|artistic]] ability.

Despite the artistic sensibilities of the native Snivvians, the history of Cadomai was an extremely [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] one, with the Snivvian [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] flaw known as the Blood Code of the Snivvian resulting in a number of brutal dictators. However, Cadomai eventually became well-known as a resort world, despite the freezing climate. Historically a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] planet, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Cadomai came to the attention of the Imperial [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]], which wanted to ensure that Cadomai's famous [[transnovel]]s would remain suitable according to the tenets of the Empire's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

==Description==
{{Quote|For a Snivvian, this is balmy.|Marn Hierogryph, on the ice world [[Jebble]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 26">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref>}}
A frigid [[Planet/Legends|world]] of tundra plains, Cadomai Prime, also known as simply Cadomai, was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="gg12" /> Cadomai was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="teaoc" /> [[Cadomai system/Legends|Cadomai system]],<ref name="aa" /> in the [[Catarlo sector/Legends|Catarlo sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the greater [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]].<ref name="teaoc" /> Cadomai was situated on the northern end of [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the planets [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]] and [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]],<ref name="tea" /> near the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]],<ref name="uaa" /> making it part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] region.<ref name="tea" /> The subfreezing environments of Cadomai led the Snivvians to evolve unique, dense skin that allowed them to control the opening and closing of their pores, in order to trap or release body heat. Cadomai [[Winter/Legends|winters]] were very long and exceptionally cold, forcing Snivvians to stay underground in<ref name="gg12" /> Cadomai Prime's extensive system of subterranean [[Cave/Legends|caverns]]<ref name="kotorcg" /> for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] at a [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="gg12" /> Above ground, Cadomai also featured large [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and canyons.<ref name="legacy6" /> Cadomai had a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]], with a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of twenty-seven [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] consisting of 405 local days. Cadomai had a standard level of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. The planet's main export to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was art, while its major imports were [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and raw materials.<ref name="kotorcg" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Sith who was exposed on Cadomai Prime was killed by Darth Wredd. Reports confirm it.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]]|<ref name="legacy6" />}}
The Snivvians descended from hunters on the frozen plains of Cadomai Prime, eventually gaining sentience and establishing a civilization on the world.<ref name="gg12" /> Many Snivvians were known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as excellent [[Artist/Legends|artists]] and [[Author/Legends|authors]], a product of Cadomai's winters&mdash;with the Snivvians forced into underground homes during these intensely cold periods, they often had little else to do but develop their artistic talents and sensibilities.<ref name="kotorcg" /> For the Snivvians, the norm was for one [[Reproduction/Legends|birthing]] to yield one [[Gender/Legends|male]] and one female, but male-male twin births sometimes occurred, albeit very rarely. In these cases, one of the two children was born with a genetic flaw, known as the [[Blood/Legends|Blood]] Code of the Snivvian, which had a chance to mutate into a personality disorder and possible sociopathic behavior. The history of Cadomai tended to be a very violent one, and the Blood Code of the Snivvian led to the downfall of a number of civilizations on the world. Three times in the history of Cadomai, Snivvians with this genetic disorder grew to become charismatic, but evil dictators&mdash;two were defeated by civilian uprisings, while the last, [[Zereldspidar]], required the intervention of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to fell. Eventually, the Snivvians mastered [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] and minimized the chance of these abnormal births. The Snivvians in time developed a participatory democracy on Cadomai, with representatives being elected to a ruling council known as a [[Chevram]]. From there, an executive [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was chosen purely on artistic skill. The Chevram was elected once every twelve years, and a new executive chosen every year of the Chevram's rule.<ref name="gg12" />

[[File:Cadomai_2.png|thumb|left|250px|Cadomai Prime]]
Eventually, the Snivvians developed [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel and were able to expand their civilization beyond Cadomai.<ref name="uaa" /> The region of space containing Cadomai was considered widely explored by the Republic by the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="tea" /> In the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, Cadomai had established itself as a prime resort world despite its cold climate. The Snivvians built large vacation complexes within their [[City/Legends|cities]], and used their artistic and creative culture as an attraction for tourists.<ref name="kotorcg" /> In the next few [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the Hydian Way hyperlane was blazed&mdash;the older [[Morellian Trail]] route, which included Cadomai, fell upon the larger Hydian. Afterwards, during the [[Jedi Civil War]], the area of space containing Cadomai fell under the control of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Cadomai eventually was returned to Republic control, however, and would remain as a Republic world until that government's [[Declaration of a New Order|fall]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="tea" />

In the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[transnovel]]s of Cadomai<ref name="imperialsourcebook" />&mdash;artistic combinations of words and images that told a story while being displayed, which the Snivvians usually created during their periods underground every winter<ref name="gg12" />&mdash;came under examination by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]], a sub-agency of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]], which was in the process of reporting on the suitability of various art forms in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Along with thousands of other types of art from across the galaxy, Cadomai transnovels were judged on a series of austere and inflexible tenets that fit in line with the philosophy of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="imperialsourcebook" /> During the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Catarlo sector, and therefore Cadomai, fell under the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governorship]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlow]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the exclusive [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury starliner]] ''[[Calabar Queen]]'' [[Attack on the Calabar Queen|exploded]] without warning on its final approach to Cadomai, taking the lives of several [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], governors, and officers in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. The [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization known as the [[Justice Action Network|Justice Action League]] quickly claimed responsibility for the disaster, declaring that it was retribution for Imperial military actions in the Outer Rim and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="aj11">{{JournalCite|11|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], three years after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the area containing Cadomai fell under the [[Zsinj's Empire|control]] of Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. In [[137 ABY]], Cadomai's region of space was under the hegemony of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="tea" /> By [[138 ABY]], Cadomai Prime was in desperate need of a new reliable trade route, after the [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Genocide on Dac|devastation]] of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]], which in turn drew a sizable criminal element to the collapsed area. A committee of three Snivvian [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] subsequently entered negotiations with a team of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] representatives to this end; unbeknownst to the others, one of the Snivvian envoys was a secret [[Unidentified Snivvian Sith|Sith operative]], who had infiltrated Cadomai's government. After an unsuccessful conference with the Gran, the Snivvian [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was [[Duel on Cadomai Prime|attacked]] by the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wredd]], who was hunting down other Sith. After a short duel, Wredd emerged victorious, [[Shiak|impaling]] the Snivvian with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and casting his foe's body at the feet of his fellow politicians. As Wredd had scraped the Snivvian's face to reveal his Sith [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], it was only then that the Snivvian politicians learned that there had been a traitor in their midst.<ref name="legacy6" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Gryph-KotOR50.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Marn Hierogryph, a Snivvian native of Cadomai Prime]]
The native Snivvians made up 99% of Cadomai Prime's population, with other species making up the remaining 1%, during the time of the Mandalorian Wars. The native Snivvians were a stocky, brown-furred [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species with large, short snouts and canine [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] protruding from their lower jaws&mdash;their thick skin provided them protection from Cadomai's intensely cold weather. The Snivvians greatly valued art in their society, and counted among their species some of the galaxy's greatest artists and authors,<ref name="kotorcg" /> with their transnovels being famous across the galaxy by the time of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="imperialsourcebook" /> In fact, their Chevram ruling council chose its executive officer every year solely on artistic skill.<ref name="gg12" />

One notable Snivvian native of Cadomai was [[Marn Hierogryph]], whose [[Parent/Legends|parents]] sent him off-world after Hierogryph's skill as a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] angered many fellow Snivvians. Hierogryph went on to become a career criminal on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], later joining the disgraced former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] in his quest for justice.<ref name="kotorcg" /> Other notable Cadomai natives included [[Sinrich/Legends|Sinrich]], a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&ndash;era [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who invented the [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic disguise matrix]];<ref name="rogues132">{{InsiderCite|132|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Who's Who: The Bounty Hunters!}}</ref> [[Tevlun]], a member of the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]];<ref name="goi">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> and [[Zutton/Legends|Zutton]],<ref name="rogues130">{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}}</ref> a well-known Snivvian artist around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="secrets">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> The [[Snivvian (language)|Snivvian language]] was the tongue mainly employed on Cadomai,<ref name="uaa" /> and Snivvians speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] were sometimes said to have a "Cadomai accent." Additionally, some natives of Cadomai, Marn Hierogryph for example, used "Spirits of Cadomai" as an exclamation.<ref name="labor">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080409/index.html|text="Labor Pains"|int=Labor Pains|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

==Locations==
[[Brella]] was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of Cadomai Prime, although it was by no means the only major city on the planet. By the time of the Mandalorian Wars, the Snivvians had begun to build resorts and vacation complexes in the other cities on the world, making Cadomai a tourist destination.<ref name="kotorcg" /> The subterranean caverns of Cadomai held extensive systems of homes that the Snivvians made use of during Cadomai's intolerable winters.<ref name="gg12" /> The world was home to the [[University of Cadomai/Legends|University of Cadomai]].<ref name="kotor36">[[Knights of the Old Republic 36|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 36]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet "Cadomai" was first mentioned in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', a [[1989]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook written by [[Greg Gorden]].<ref name="imperialsourcebook" /> Much of the extant information on Cadomai was added by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] in the sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'',<ref name="gg12" /> and in the ''[[Alien Anthology]]''&mdash;where the name Cadomai Prime was first entered into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]<ref name="aa" />&mdash;and the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'',<ref name="kotorcg" /> along with the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="tea" /> The ''Alien Anthology'' originally placed Cadomai Prime in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="aa" /> although several later sources, including ''The Essential Atlas'', placed it in the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="tea" /> Cadomai Prime makes its first direct appearance in the [[2013]] comic [[Legacy (2013) 6|''Legacy'' (2013) 6]], where it was drawn by [[Brian Albert Thies|Brian Thies]].<ref name="legacy6" />
